meta.name: config-explorer
meta.description: Inspect and safely edit the Claude Code and Codex configuration surfaces exposed by CCAM. Use when auditing skills, agents, commands, plugins, marketplaces, MCP servers, hooks, settings, memory, keybindings, profiles, rules, or instruction files, and when a backup-backed allowlisted edit is required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安全查看并调整 AI 编码助手的各项配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要调整 AI 编码助手的行为设置并担心改错。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and safely edit AI coding assistant configurations with backup support.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to audit and safely modify AI coding assistant settings with backup protection.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查看和修改 Claude Code 与 Codex 的配置。它读取技能、代理、命令等配置项,并在自动备份后执行有限修改,如文本产物和按键绑定。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看或修改 Claude Code 或 Codex 的配置,如技能、代理、命令等,或要求备份保护的编辑时触发。

say.text: 查看我的 Claude Code 技能配置
检查当前配置了哪些 MCP 服务器
say.note: 显示 MCP 服务器列表。

say.text: 查看 Codex 的配置概览
say.note: 显示 Codex 的配置摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can inspect and modify configurations for Claude Code and Codex. It reads items like skills, agents, commands, etc., and performs limited edits (text artifacts and keybindings) with automatic backups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to view or edit Claude Code or Codex configuration, such as skills, agents, commands, etc., or requests backup-backed edits.

say_en.text: Show my Claude Code skills configuration
Check which MCP servers are configured

say_en.note: Displays a summary of Codex config.
